plain.li: [inherited] The machines took a lot from {NAME}. I'm going to {GOAL} and take some of it back.
I saw what the machines did to the last place I lived. I'm going to put ten of them in the dirt, to start.
[afterraid] The last attack is still smoking outside the walls. Next time it's machines, I want to be the one who stops them. Ten of them, at least.

blunt.li: Machines don't bleed and they don't beg, so I won't lose any sleep over ten of them.

cheerful.li: I'm going to fight ten robots! I've already named my weapon.

cold.li: Mechanoid weak points: joints, sensor clusters, power cores. I've written them down. Ten units is the target.

plain.li: Ten machines, broken open in the dirt. I kept a bolt from each one. They're on a string by my bed.
[hurt] Ten mechanoids down. The last one got its claws into me first, and I'm still picking bits of it out of my arm.

gloomy.li: Ten down, and they'll build a hundred more. Still, that's ten.

cold.li: Ten mechanoids destroyed. Whoever built them won't have noticed.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a home in the mountain
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: carve a home out of the mountain

plain.li: [inherited] The tunnel {NAME} started into the hillside only goes about ten paces. I'll {GOAL}, beginning where {NAME}'s pick stopped.
Walls fall down and roofs cave in, but this mountain has stood for ages. I'm going to dig us a home inside it.
[trait:Undergrounder] I sleep better with stone over my head. I want all of us under the mountain, deep and dry. I'll dig it myself if I have to.
[work:Mining] Every swing of the pick makes more room. I want this mountain hollowed out like a gourd before I'm done with it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to dig a whole house into the mountain, with rooms and a hallway. I've always wanted a hallway!

gloomy.li: The sky out here has never done us any favors. I'm going to put a mountain between us and it.

plain.li: I walked from one end of what I've dug to the other today, and it took a while.
[trait:Undergrounder] Deep, quiet and ours. The mountain holds us like a pair of cupped hands now.

blunt.li: Five hundred cuts of rock. My arms hurt. The mountain lost.

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} had the steadiest hands in the colony. I'll {GOAL} with {NAME}'s knives, and try to keep mine as steady.
Bandages are one thing. I want to be the one they trust to open someone up and put them back together. Twenty operations, done right.
[tribal] The old healers worked with a sharp stone and a steady breath. I want to learn their art properly, twenty times over, until my hands stop shaking.

warm.li: When someone's on the table, they're trusting me with everything. I want to earn that twenty times.

gloomy.li: Someone will always need cutting open out here. It might as well be me holding the knife, and holding it steady.

cold.li: Twenty procedures. Enough repetitions to stop thinking and start knowing.

plain.li: Twenty operations. I could find my way around the inside of a person with my eyes closed now.

warm.li: Twenty times someone lay down and trusted me. Twenty times, I tried to deserve it.

blunt.li: Twenty. My hands don't shake anymore. That was the point.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: dignity for the dead
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: give fifteen of the dead a proper burial

plain.li: [sparked] No one should be left lying in the open like that. I'll see that ours are buried properly.
[inherited] Every grave {NAME} dug was straight and deep and marked. I'll {GOAL} with {NAME}'s old shovel, and dig them the same way.
Raider or friend, they shouldn't be left out for the birds. I've started digging.

warm.li: Everyone was somebody's child once. I'm going to make sure fifteen of them get a proper grave, even the ones who came here to kill us.
[winter] The ground's frozen hard and the dead keep coming. I'll break it anyway.
We'll all need a grave someday. I'd like to think someone will dig mine with care. So I'll start with theirs.

plain.li: Fifteen graves, every one dug straight and marked. I know where each of them lies.

warm.li: I said a few words over every one of them. I didn't know most of their names. I said the words anyway.
[afterraid] Fifteen graves now, and the raids keep making more dead than one person can bury. I'll keep going.

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} swept these floors every morning, and they've gone filthy since. I mean to {GOAL}.
Blood, mud, vomit, ash. I'm going to clean up four hundred messes, and I'm counting.
[trait:Industrious] Idle hands make me itch. Filthy floors make me itch worse. Four hundred messes, and then I'll rest. Maybe.
[afterraid] There's still blood on the floor from the last attack and everyone just walks around it. Not anymore. I'm cleaning this colony top to bottom, and keeping it that way.

blunt.li: This place is filthy and no one else seems to care. Fine. I'll do it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to make this place sparkle! Four hundred messes, gone.

plain.li: Four hundred messes. Someone ate off the kitchen floor today on a dare and didn't get sick.

cheerful.li: Four hundred! I could see my face in the kitchen floor this morning.

gloomy.li: Four hundred messes cleaned. There's already another one by the door. There always will be.

plain.li: [inherited] I can barely follow the notes {NAME} left behind. I'll work through every page and {GOAL}.
Somewhere in all these notes there's an idea nobody's had yet. I'm going to find it if it takes me years.
[tribal] The ancients knew things we've forgotten. I'm going to learn them back, one by one, until I find something they never knew.
[spacer] We have machines that think and engines that cross the stars, and still no one understands half of what's out here. I'd like to understand some of it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to discover something! I don't know what yet, which is the point.

cold.li: Our knowledge is a patchwork of half-remembered manuals. I intend to add something original to it.

plain.li: It clicked tonight. Months of notes, and suddenly they all pointed the same way. I ran outside and told the first person I saw, who didn't understand a word of it.

warm.li: I made a discovery, and the whole colony will be safer for it. That's the part I'll remember.

cold.li: Breakthrough achieved. I've documented it thoroughly. It will outlast me.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a hunter's legend
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: bring home forty kills from the hunt

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} knew every game trail for a day's walk around here. I'll walk them all and {GOAL}.
Forty kills from the hunt. I'd like them still telling stories about me long after I'm gone.
[tribal] My grandmother's grandmother brought down a thrumbo with a spear. I'm not asking for that. Forty good kills, and a story worth telling.
[winter] Winter's long and the stores are thin. I'm going to keep the pot full. Forty kills, every one of them clean.

blunt.li: Meat doesn't walk into the storeroom on its own. I'll bring in forty.

cold.li: Tracking, patience, one shot. Repeated forty times. A reasonable discipline.

plain.li: Forty. I could track a squirrel across bare rock now. The animals have started to know my smell.
[trait:Kind] Forty kills, all of them quick. I thanked every one. It sounds silly written down.

blunt.li: Forty kills. Meat in the storeroom, hides on the racks. Ask me about any one of them.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: the one who puts out the fires

plain.li: [inherited] Whenever there was smoke, {NAME} was the first one running toward it. Now that's my job. I'll {GOAL}.
Everything here burns sooner or later. I'm going to be the one who runs toward it.
[summer] The grass is dry and the lightning's close. Fires are coming. I want to be the one standing in front of them.

blunt.li: Somebody has to stand in the smoke with a beater. Might as well be someone who's decided to be good at it.

cheerful.li: I'm going to be the colony's official fire-stopper! Well, unofficial, until someone makes it official.

gloomy.li: I watched a whole house burn once, with people still inside. I won't watch that here.

plain.li: Thirty fires out. My eyebrows have grown back three times. I smell like smoke even after a bath.

warm.li: Thirty fires, and nobody lost to any of them while I was there. I'll take that.

cold.li: Thirty fires extinguished. Combustion is predictable. Carelessness, less so.

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} could hit a hare at the far end of the field. I'll practice every day until I {GOAL} too.
Raiders don't wait for you to steady your hands. I'm going to practice until mine don't need steadying.
[trait:Bloodlust] I love the moment right before the shot. I want to get so good at {SKILL} that it's the only moment there is.
[tribal] The best hunters in the old stories could split a reed at a hundred paces. I'll settle for ninety.

blunt.li: I can hit things. I want to hit the exact thing I'm aiming at, every time.

cold.li: Accuracy is a skill like any other. Practice, measure, correct. I will become precise.

plain.li: I put three shots through the same hole today. Nobody believed me, so I did it again.
[trait:Bloodlust] I'm the best shot here now. Let them come. I mean it.

blunt.li: Crack shot. The next raiders will find out the hard way.

plain.li: [inherited] When {NAME} spoke at meetings, people put their spoons down to listen. I want to {GOAL} like that.
When I talk at meetings, people's eyes drift. I want to learn to hold a room, so the right ideas win.

warm.li: Words can stop fights and start friendships. I want to be good enough with them to do both on purpose.

blunt.li: Apparently I "come across badly." Fine. I'll learn to come across however I like. Then we'll see.

cheerful.li: I'm going to be the most charming person on the Rim! I've been practicing my smile in the water barrel.

cold.li: Persuasion is leverage without force. I intend to learn how to apply it.

plain.li: I spoke at dinner tonight, and the room went quiet to listen without anyone asking for quiet.

cheerful.li: People ask my opinion now, on purpose! I've had to start having more opinions.

cold.li: They listen when I speak. It took years. It was worth the investment.

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME}'s books are still stacked by the bed. I'm going to read every one of them and {GOAL}.
Everyone here thinks I'm clever. I want to actually be as clever as I act. That's going to take some work.
[night] Can't sleep. Too many questions. I've decided to stop fighting it and start answering them, properly, one at a time.

blunt.li: Most people stop learning once they know enough to get by. I'm not most people.

gloomy.li: The more I learn, the more I see how little anyone knows. I want to know all of it anyway, even if it doesn't help.

cold.li: I've read everything in the colony twice, and it isn't enough.

plain.li: I caught myself explaining something today that I didn't know a year ago, and explaining it well. I think I'm a scholar now.

cheerful.li: I know so many things now! Please, somebody ask me something.

cold.li: My understanding is thorough now, and still incomplete. I find I like it that way.

plain.li: [inherited] There's a sculpture in the workshop that {NAME} never finished. I won't touch it, but I'll {GOAL} in {NAME}'s memory.
I want to make something beautiful enough that strangers stop to look at it.
[lowmood] Making things is the only time my head goes quiet. I want to get good enough that it stays quiet longer.

warm.li: One day someone will walk past a piece of mine and feel better for it. I want to get that good.

cheerful.li: I'm going to be a great artist! Right now I'm a medium one, so there's work to do.

gloomy.li: Everything here is mud and blood and walls. I want to leave one beautiful thing behind before this place takes me.

plain.li: I finished a piece today and stood back, and for once I didn't see the mistakes first. I saw what I meant.

warm.li: Someone cried in front of my latest work. Good tears. I've been floating ever since.

cold.li: My work is finally equal to my intentions. A rare condition. I'll try to keep it.

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} always knew where to put people when the alarm went. I'll {GOAL} and follow {NAME}'s plans.
When the alarm goes, people look around for someone to tell them what to do. I want it to be me they look at.
[afterraid] That raid was chaos, with no one in charge and everyone shouting. Next time I want to be marshal, and I want there to be a plan.

blunt.li: I'd make a good marshal. Better than some. I'll say that to anyone's face.

cold.li: Defense requires one mind directing many hands. I'll be that mind.

plain.li: Marshal. The colony trusts me with its walls and everyone behind them. I checked every barricade twice tonight.
[trait:Bloodlust] I'm marshal. Let the raiders learn my name. Let them come and learn it properly.

gloomy.li: I'm marshal now. Whoever dies on the wall from now on, I'll be the one who put them there.

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} kept the infirmary going on almost nothing. I'm going to {GOAL} and keep it going.
I want the keys to the infirmary, not for the title but because I know how to run it.
[hurt] Lying in that bed gave me a lot of time to think about how I'd run the infirmary. Better than this. I'm going to be physician.

warm.li: When people are hurting, they should know exactly where to find me. I'd like the council to make it official.

cold.li: Medical decisions are being made by whoever happens to be nearby. That's inefficient. I'll take the physician's seat.

plain.li: They made me physician. The first thing I did was reorganize the medicine shelf; the second was have a good cry.

warm.li: Physician. Everyone who's sick here is my responsibility now. I wouldn't have it any other way.

blunt.li: Physician. Good. Nobody gets to argue with my splints anymore.

plain.li: [inherited] On the bad days, {NAME} was the one who got us laughing again. I'll {GOAL} and try to do the same.
Somebody needs to remember birthdays and plan the feasts. I want to be the one who keeps this colony's spirits up.
[trait:Ascetic] People here want too much and end up disappointed too often. I'd teach them to enjoy what we have. Steward suits me.

warm.li: I want everyone here to have one good evening a week, no matter what. Steward is how I make that happen.
[lowmood] Everyone's been so miserable lately, me included. Somebody needs to fix that. I'm going to try for steward.

plain.li: I'm steward. I've already planned three festivals and a party. Two of them are probably too ambitious.
[trait:Ascetic] Steward now. My first act: a simple meal, everyone together, nothing fancy. People liked it more than they expected to.

warm.li: Steward. My job is making people happy. I didn't know you could be given that job.

plain.li: [inherited] The stores have been a mess since we lost {NAME}. I'll {GOAL} and set them right.
I know exactly what's in every stockpile, down to the last nail. It's about time someone gave me the keys.
[trait:Greedy] Quartermaster. Imagine it. All the silver in the colony, counted by me, every evening. Just counted. Mostly.

cheerful.li: I want to be quartermaster! I love lists and counting and a well-stacked shelf.

cold.li: Our stores are mismanaged. I could run them at a profit within a season. Quartermaster is the obvious seat.

plain.li: Quartermaster. I walked every stockpile with a slate and counted it all twice. Everything is where it should be. For now.
[trait:Greedy] They gave me the keys to everything. I'm holding them right now. They're very heavy and very nice.

blunt.li: Quartermaster. The traders had better bring their best prices from now on.

plain.li: [inherited] There wasn't room for all the mourners at {NAME}'s grave. I'd like to be loved like that, so I'm going to {GOAL}.
I have friends here, but I'd like a table so full that somebody has to sit on a crate.
[newcomer] I barely know anyone's name yet. By the time I'm done here, I want five of them to be friends.

warm.li: Every friend I've made here has made this place warmer. I'd like five.

cheerful.li: Five best friends! I've made a list of candidates, and no, you can't see it.

gloomy.li: When I die, I want five people standing at my grave who mean it.

plain.li: Five friends. Real ones. I had them all over for dinner, it got loud, and someone broke a chair.

warm.li: Five people who'd come looking for me in a storm. I'm the luckiest person on this planet.

cheerful.li: Five best friends, a whole hand of them! I counted on my fingers to be sure.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: the long haul
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see five more years with the colony

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} wanted to grow old here. I'm going to {GOAL}, and grow old for both of us.
Five more years. I'd like to see this place grow up, and be here for it.
[old] My knees know every winter by name now. I'd like to meet five more of them. Then I'll think about resting.

cheerful.li: Five more years here! Think of all the harvests and birthdays, and the arguments about chores.

gloomy.li: [old] Everyone my age is in the ground already. I'm going to be stubborn about it. Five more years, at least.

cold.li: Life expectancy here is poor. I intend to be an outlier. Five years.

plain.li: Five more years. I remember the day I made the promise. I'm still here, and so is the colony.
[old] Five more winters, and I'm still the first one up in the morning. The young ones can't believe it. Neither can I.

warm.li: Five years with these people, and every one of them was worth it, even the bad ones.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a town on the rim
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see {COUNT} people call this place home

plain.li: [inherited] Back when we all ate at one small table, {NAME} was already calling this place a town. I'll {GOAL} and make it true.
I want a town. Not a camp, not a hideout. A town, with neighbors you don't like and gossip that travels.
[small] There's only a handful of us. One bad raid and we're gone. I want this place to grow until nothing can wipe it out.

warm.li: There's room here for so many more. I want to see it full, every bed taken, every chair at dinner filled.

cold.li: A colony of twenty or more stops being fragile. I intend to see us cross that line.

plain.li: I stood out past the fields at dusk and counted the lights. We built a town.

cheerful.li: We're a town now! I don't even know all the names yet.

gloomy.li: So many people now. So many more to lose. Still, I wouldn't change it.
